title: Cost of Attendance (USC Financial Aid)
text:
ACADEMIC YEAR: 2026-2027 Estimate of Cost of Attendance. These are estimated two-semester costs for a full-time undergraduate taking 12-18 units each semester.

ESTIMATED COST OF ATTENDANCE, 2026-2027
| Category | On Campus | Off Campus | With Parents or Relatives |
| Tuition | $75,384 | $75,384 | $75,384 |
| Fees | $1,952 | $1,952 | $1,952 |
| Housing (includes average USC housing amount) | $13,510 | $13,140 | $8,776 |
| Food (includes standard meal plan) | $8,442 | $8,442 | $3,762 |
| Books/Supplies | $670 | $670 | $670 |
| Transportation | $1,188 | $1,188 | $2,070 |
| Personal/Misc | $2,016 | $2,016 | $2,016 |
| Total | $103,162 | $102,792 | $94,630 |

A $450 new student fee applies in the first semester.

PRIOR YEAR (also listed on the page): 2025-2026 totals were $99,139 (on or off campus) and $86,581 (with parents or relatives).

NOTES
- Actual costs may vary by major, and some majors may have higher budgets due to lab, studio, or other program costs.
- To receive the full amount of aid you may qualify for, you must meet eligibility requirements and submit your aid application(s) by the deadlines.

CONTACTS
